checks.degree_identity: Exact Artificial Intelligence, BA heading; 2026-2027 Bulletin; distinct award record.
checks.required_and_choices: Independently read fixed core: MATH 121, MATH 307, CSDS 233, CSDS 302, CSDS 310, CSDS 330, CSDS 340, CSDS 395A. Introductory programming is CSDS 134 OR the complete CSDS 132+237 bundle, never three fixed requirements. Calculus II and probability are also alternatives; BS calculus III is an alternative. BA application pool now has alternative choice ancestry, preserving one3–4-credit or two1.5-credit selection; BS four-elective direct memberships already carry choice ancestry despite contextual subgroup notes.
checks.elective_pools: Named major pools and all thirteen published UGER approval tables were read. Whole course sequences, conditional approvals and non-course engagement routes remain explicit; subject-wide breadth and BS any-CSDS/prior-approval rules remain open rather than fabricated finite inventories. Course prerequisites do not add fixed degree obligations. BA application choices retain one 3–4-unit or two 1.5-unit alternatives; graduate-program SCMG enrollment restrictions have a conditional registrar permission route, not an automatic waiver.
checks.prerequisites: All mapped course-source blocks reviewed for stated prerequisites, corequisites, class/major restrictions, consent, repeat limits and credit exclusions. Unstated prerequisites remain null. Registrar requisite and separate career permissions are conditional and not guaranteed. Specific conditions include CSDS102 before 300-level CSDS enrollment, invitation-only physics, graduate/permission alternatives, major-specific capstones, MGMT395 three distinct sections for DC, and THTR395 both senior-year semesters. Source-sentence continuation check also preserves ANEE381 requirements ANEE107+316, rather than stopping at its major/standing sentence.
checks.credits_and_units: Published individual amounts retained, including fractional and known-zero credits. Variable ranges remain null scalars with original ranges in notes/rerun observations. Headers use Units; only previously corroborated credit-hour units are retained, with no invented conversion. Wellness duration is independent of credits; complete sequence amounts are not divided among components without course-source evidence.
checks.classification: All 744 mapped course records have source-backed subject reviews: 683 reviewed, 38 mixed and 23 unclassified. Mixed/unspecified topics retain other; 20 records lack substantive descriptions (principally label-only wellness listings). Descriptions are original paraphrases with source-body freshness guards. Review combined degree researcher reads with coordinator HSTY/religion/English/art/language reads; not a second independent review of every course. Final reconciliation registers 37 groups/54 aliases; independently derived required/options/duration-only role sets match the profile. Differently scoped language/capstone versions and catalog identity typos remain separate.
checks.family_composition: No family inheritance; BA and BS have independent catalog curricula and stable IDs.
checks.degree_wide_requirements: Bachelor and UGER governing prose and thirteen approval tables read: award/cohort rules, GPA/residency, breadth outside STEM+N, overlap, transfer/appeal, four mandatory communication stages/portfolio, wellness duration and perspectives. Eight course bundles and eight non-course engagement routes remain intact. Coordinator independently verified the degree-wide/UGER/permission scope (0944f7e); direct source-table roles and manually reviewed fixed sets establish final expected profiles. This bounded independent check does not certify a full second pass over every course.

discrepancies.issue: All computing foundations fell through a narrow shared title heuristic into other; CSDS discrete mathematics and BS engineering-impact subject were also misclassified.
discrepancies.correction: Case-specific exact code/title map plus independently parsed official description evidence; source-backed manual category_review and paraphrases. The generic helper and shared profile are unchanged.

discrepancies.issue: BA application listing conflicts with graduate-only SCMG 462/463 enrollment restrictions.
discrepancies.correction: Earlier conflict interpretation superseded by actual registrar policies covering unmet course conditions and separate cross-career permissions. Retain exact enrollment restrictions and conditional approval route; restore BA scoped inventory complete, while full correctness audit remains in progress.

discrepancies.issue: Mandatory communication sequence was represented by a note parent, suppressing its four explicit choice pools into unresolved roles.
discrepancies.correction: Changed the communication parent to all; inquiry/CI/DC/capstone retain source counts and complete bundled alternatives. Portfolio policy remains prose. Wellness duration remains unresolved because semester-equivalent selection is not a fixed course-count choice.

discrepancies.issue: Inquiry summary implied everyone outside preparatory English enters AIQS 120.
discrepancies.correction: Restricted the direct AIQS 120 observation to some students for whom English is a second language, matching the actual source scope.

discrepancies.issue: Java programming appears under CSDS132 in the major and ECSE132 in the UGER pool; counting both as independent courses duplicates an explicitly cross-listed identity.
discrepancies.correction: Retained both records and registered one reviewed cross-list group from reciprocal course-description statements. CSDS134 remains a distinct alternative; credit exclusion alone is not equivalence.

discrepancies.issue: Additional reviewed history/religion/humanities aliases were separately counted as mapped identities.
discrepancies.correction: Registered 37 reciprocal-source groups/54 aliases after reading all mapped descriptions. Retained every source record and selection quantity; excluded differing language/capstone versions and unresolved identity typos.

discrepancies.issue: Replacing the UGER table course title with the official MGMT395 description title could lose the three-section completion rule.
discrepancies.correction: Moved the observed three-section condition into the DC requirement summary; guarded parser and regression preserve it independently of course-title normalization.

discrepancies.issue: The explicitly mandatory application-course alternatives were represented as a note, incorrectly making their pool unresolved in the course profile.
discrepancies.correction: Changed the requirement to alternative with its exact one3–4-credit OR two1.5-credit condition; retained all source pool records and individual course restrictions. No fixed obligation or per-course amount inferred.

programs.correction_status: Primary whole-degree audit complete: current source requirements, eligibility, course content, explicit unknowns, reciprocal identities and independent role/category expected sets verified. Independent full-degree second pass remains pending.

checks.degree_identity: Exact Artificial Intelligence, BS heading; 2026-2027 Bulletin; distinct award record.
checks.required_and_choices: Independently read fixed core: MATH 121, MATH 307, CSDS 233, CSDS 302, CSDS 310, CSDS 330, CSDS 340, CSDS 395A, ENGR 399. Introductory programming is CSDS 134 OR the complete CSDS 132+237 bundle, never three fixed requirements. Calculus II and probability are also alternatives; BS calculus III is an alternative. BA application pool now has alternative choice ancestry, preserving one3–4-credit or two1.5-credit selection; BS four-elective direct memberships already carry choice ancestry despite contextual subgroup notes.
checks.elective_pools: Named major pools and all thirteen published UGER approval tables were read. Whole course sequences, conditional approvals and non-course engagement routes remain explicit; subject-wide breadth and BS any-CSDS/prior-approval rules remain open rather than fabricated finite inventories. Course prerequisites do not add fixed degree obligations.
checks.prerequisites: All mapped course-source blocks reviewed for stated prerequisites, corequisites, class/major restrictions, consent, repeat limits and credit exclusions. Unstated prerequisites remain null. Registrar requisite and separate career permissions are conditional and not guaranteed. Specific conditions include CSDS102 before 300-level CSDS enrollment, invitation-only physics, graduate/permission alternatives, major-specific capstones, MGMT395 three distinct sections for DC, and THTR395 both senior-year semesters. Source-sentence continuation check also preserves ANEE381 requirements ANEE107+316, rather than stopping at its major/standing sentence.
checks.credits_and_units: Published individual amounts retained, including fractional and known-zero credits. Variable ranges remain null scalars with original ranges in notes/rerun observations. Headers use Units; only previously corroborated credit-hour units are retained, with no invented conversion. Wellness duration is independent of credits; complete sequence amounts are not divided among components without course-source evidence.
checks.classification: All 756 mapped course records have source-backed subject reviews: 694 reviewed, 39 mixed and 23 unclassified. Mixed/unspecified topics retain other; 20 records lack substantive descriptions (principally label-only wellness listings). Descriptions are original paraphrases with source-body freshness guards. Review combined degree researcher reads with coordinator HSTY/religion/English/art/language reads; not a second independent review of every course. Final reconciliation registers 38 groups/55 aliases; independently derived required/options/duration-only role sets match the profile. Differently scoped language/capstone versions and catalog identity typos remain separate.
checks.family_composition: No family inheritance; BA and BS have independent catalog curricula and stable IDs.
checks.degree_wide_requirements: Bachelor and UGER governing prose and thirteen approval tables read: award/cohort rules, GPA/residency, breadth outside STEM+N, overlap, transfer/appeal, four mandatory communication stages/portfolio, wellness duration and perspectives. Eight course bundles and eight non-course engagement routes remain intact. Coordinator independently verified the degree-wide/UGER/permission scope (0944f7e); direct source-table roles and manually reviewed fixed sets establish final expected profiles. This bounded independent check does not certify a full second pass over every course.

discrepancies.issue: All computing foundations fell through a narrow shared title heuristic into other; CSDS discrete mathematics and BS engineering-impact subject were also misclassified.
discrepancies.correction: Case-specific exact code/title map plus independently parsed official description evidence; source-backed manual category_review and paraphrases. The generic helper and shared profile are unchanged.

discrepancies.issue: Mandatory communication sequence was represented by a note parent, suppressing its four explicit choice pools into unresolved roles.
discrepancies.correction: Changed the communication parent to all; inquiry/CI/DC/capstone retain source counts and complete bundled alternatives. Portfolio policy remains prose. Wellness duration remains unresolved because semester-equivalent selection is not a fixed course-count choice.

discrepancies.issue: Inquiry summary implied everyone outside preparatory English enters AIQS 120.
discrepancies.correction: Restricted the direct AIQS 120 observation to some students for whom English is a second language, matching the actual source scope.

discrepancies.issue: Java programming appears under CSDS132 in the major and ECSE132 in the UGER pool; counting both as independent courses duplicates an explicitly cross-listed identity.
discrepancies.correction: Retained both records and registered one reviewed cross-list group from reciprocal course-description statements. CSDS134 remains a distinct alternative; credit exclusion alone is not equivalence.

discrepancies.issue: Additional reviewed history/religion/humanities aliases were separately counted as mapped identities.
discrepancies.correction: Registered 38 reciprocal-source groups/55 aliases after reading all mapped descriptions. Retained every source record and selection quantity; excluded differing language/capstone versions and unresolved identity typos.

discrepancies.issue: Replacing the UGER table course title with the official MGMT395 description title could lose the three-section completion rule.
discrepancies.correction: Moved the observed three-section condition into the DC requirement summary; guarded parser and regression preserve it independently of course-title normalization.

programs.correction_status: Primary whole-degree audit complete: current source requirements, eligibility, course content, explicit unknowns, reciprocal identities and independent role/category expected sets verified. Independent full-degree second pass remains pending.
